prs.title: Reduce qualified solver work and add rigorous theory/performance audit
prs.body:
## 문제

완료된 explicit 후보가 비용 하한으로 이미 패배한 implicit return comparator를 계속 기다리고, 미완료 비교가 완료된 비교처럼 기록됩니다. 별도로 Faer dense solve의 반복 할당, analytic partial-time temporary, projected residual 행 복사가 수치식을 바꾸지 않고 줄일 수 있는 비용입니다.

## 변경

- 기본 false인 `stop_dominated_return_comparator` 옵션으로 ordinary return comparator를 보수적인 비용 하한에서 중단합니다. 관측한 fatal callback의 우선순위와 checkpoint 보존을 유지합니다.
- 모든 미완료 비교를 별도 prefix-cost predicate와 evidence enum으로 표시합니다. 비용 합계와 ratio는 외향 반올림합니다.
- `LuSolveWorkspace`를 통해 aligned RHS와 permutation scratch를 재사용합니다. MF analytic partial_t는 기존 into API를 사용하고 coupled residual은 행을 빌려 사용합니다.
- 최신 31개 issue packet을 비판적으로 대조한 감사, 4개 조건부 정리의 완전한 증명, 이상적 DOPRI dispersion 유도, 연구 Rust primitive, REVTeX 원문과 원자료를 추가합니다.

## 실제 검증과 결과

- Native targeted tests **51 PASS**, standalone research Rust tests **7 PASS**.
- Dense n=65/96/192: 33개 공통 관측 시각의 모든 상태·native counters·attempt 수가 기준과 동일하고 정확해 상한을 통과합니다.
- LU의 7개 차원에서 기존 풀이와 비트 동일, warmed solve 추가 할당 0회.
- Adapter n=16: work 2655→2605, RHS 1216→1200; 전체 accepted trajectory 동일.
- Callgrind instruction slope: LU n=32 **13.196% 감소**, full dense n=65 **2.605% 감소**, full adapter n=16 **1.731% 감소**.
- 두 번의 paired timing에서 모든 block 범위가 1을 가로질렀으므로 **안정적인 wall-clock 가속을 주장하지 않습니다**. 원자료에 반전·회귀·비활성 셀을 보존했습니다.
- Shifted-system 실험은 27개 norm checks와 **25/27 residual 성공**을 구별합니다. 실패 2개와 반복수 증가를 보존하고 새 relaxation을 production default에 연결하지 않았습니다.

## 검토할 범위

새 enum/config field는 exhaustive match/struct literal에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다. 외향 비교는 일반 정수 동률에서도 이전보다 보수적인 결정을 할 수 있습니다. 생략한 callback 후반부의 미래 fatal까지 예측한다고 주장하지 않습니다. Callgrind 계수는 native 초 단위 가속률이 아닙니다.

기존 V6/V8 ledger와 닫힌 물리 캠페인은 변경하지 않았습니다. 반복 entry pilot, MF QR/provider 비용, whole-domain physical certification은 남은 과제입니다.

보고서와 재현 절차: `research/rigorous_performance_audit_20261027/README_KO.md`, `REPRODUCE.md`, `report/vigilode_audit.tex`. 원시 measurements는 `evidence/raw_measurements.tar.xz`, 해시 목록은 `MANIFEST.json`에 있습니다.

prs.title: research: hybrid structural packets, local AD and continuous certified trajectories
prs.body:
## User-requested synthesis and native implementation

Stacked on PR75; no merge or default change. Implements a sealed reflecting-grid family combining exact collective/transverse reduction where valid, local directional AD elsewhere, an O(N)-storage band-plus-rank-one shifted resolvent, imported coupled/sequential candidates, and a shared adaptive quintic/cubic continuous-defect gate.

This is not a generic certified ODE/PDE solver. The model is q'=d*Delta_path*q-lambda*q+alpha*mean(q)*(1-q)-epsilon*q^2 with a verified invariant box, lambda>=alpha>=0 and epsilon>=0. Exact packet is allowed only at epsilon=0 and supported grids. No full state Jacobian is assembled by the new native candidate paths; local derivative coefficients are explicitly formed for the structured solve. This is weaker than the prior absolute no-derivative contract, as the user requested.

## Actual evidence

Measured source **49ca3150c68d527a275c855ecf814122ff9c533a**, run **39378576576**.
-19 Rust tests passed (12extended,4initial,3native integration), no full-workspace claim.
-102 accuracy-calibration/control runs,84 under the empirical1e-6 output ceiling; all selected40configurations completed160fresh timing processes/480timed full trajectories.
-32paired comparisons,22 with achieved output-error scores within factor2. Four blocks only: diagnostic ranges, not production/statistical promotion.
-Exact-rational readback verified87056continuous residual coefficients,203segments,600returned output bounds,rollback and32paired medians. Status PASS_SCOPED_RATIONAL_CERTIFICATE_AND_RAW_READBACK.

The continuous certificate is conditional on the generated model/domain and IEEE arithmetic without fast-math/FTZ. It propagates inherited uncertainty and includes returned-point rounding. It is independent of the Radau reference used for benchmarking. Spatial discretization/remap error, arbitrary callbacks and formal/independent-personnel review are not claimed.

## Critical result

N64,epsilon1: under the SAME new certificate driver, old eager endpoint44.768ms, residual/local-AD39.384ms, structured-AD/auto3.930ms. Local AD alone did not measurably beat full-graph AD. External Diffsol0.16.1 dense BDF0.541ms and Netlib DVODE dense0.464ms are much shorter but do not compute this continuous certificate. Do not present the hybrid as faster than these external implementations or treat unequal certificate contracts as identical work. Exact external-error matching is separately flagged per pair.

Cubic/quintic, partial AD counts, exact-closure and epsilon!=0 refusal, low-rank preservation, source pins, raw samples and empirical references are retained in research/hybrid_20261020/runs/39378576576. A critical synthesis/replay document will be added to this same PR. The first native integration build failed on a MutexGuard borrow expression; the failure log is preserved and the successful source repairs that type error without changing numerical criteria.

No changes to existing PR74/75, original numerical crates or root Cargo. No generic optimal-selector, zero-allocation, AMR/ALE or general stiff-uniform fifth-order promotion.

prs.title: research: residual-first coupled correction, exact-output benchmarks and bounded speculation
prs.body:
## Implemented next native node

Stacked on PR74 (`research/coupled-matrix-free-rust-20261020`), without merging or changing existing eager/default solvers. Parent companion source: `15c43ce76734d0a560fcec5909ac49f1e6f2d347`.

New opt-in APIs:
- `coupled_step_residual_first(...)`: compute the same projected residual from the same retained stage states before requesting current-stage JVP derivatives. No unused derivative at converged or update-exhausted iterates. Original full-space and embedded checks remain.
- `coupled_or_sequential_budgeted(..., candidate_jvp_cap)`: clamp candidate JVP budget to the smaller of caller/config and explicit cap, then use the unchanged protected sequential-MF fallback if eligible. Failed candidate/fallback work remains recorded. This is not a total-time bound or an optimal routing policy.

Actual derivative dispatches now have a separate Work counter; `max_batches` counts them. Existing eager API is preserved. No edits to upstream core/integrators/krylov crates or root Cargo configuration.

## Actual execution, not planned results

- RED run39353982085: 3 expected unused-derivative failures, 1 passing output control.
- **Measured source:** `f08d152a35fb2db748692570969cb1723c287c26`, published before build.
- **Successful tests/benchmark/readback run:**39355449893.
- **33 Rust tests passed:** prior19 plus new14, covering exact outputs, no-unused-JVP semantics, RHS/derivative failure accounting, epoch boundaries, cap clamping, full-space checks and fallback. Clippy executed with warnings retained; no whole-workspace PASS claimed.
- 80 accuracy rows; 76 pass the frozen root-reference gate and 48 ALSO pass the embedded time-error criterion. Fixed-h root completion is not physical timestep acceptance.
- 640 fresh timing processes, 1920 timed attempts, 8 balanced blocks, 50 prespecified paired comparisons. All50 comparisons complete, but3 are explicitly failed-attempt latency, not solver speed.
- Scalar readback: 684 metrics, 630 work ledgers, 270 cap checks, 608 timing/calibration identities, 27 full-stage/output/embedded bit comparisons, 18 exact saved-work comparisons, 50 paired medians; 71 content-addressed state objects.

## Results and negative findings

Few-mode n12288,h0.001: eager1=18.7896ms versus residual-first1=13.2862ms; paired ratio1.4117, family interval[1.3969,1.4241]. Eager4=8.99712ms versus residual-first4=7.73760ms; paired ratio1.1656,[1.1187,1.1921]. Outputs, full stage and embedded vectors are bit-identical. The same-host generic sequential-MF cost was7.70978ms, so no broad superiority over sequential is claimed.

Actual total JVP reductions: few-mode59→35, chain144→80, diffusion348→188. RHS and full-space validation are retained. Extra derivative dispatches can consume the benefit on small problems; some4worker intervals include1.

**Fixed cap64/256 is NOT recommended as an optimal/default policy.** Chain n384,h0.001 needs80candidateJVPs and finishes the uncapped transaction in1.00239ms; cap64 discards it and incurs10.75417ms with fallback. On broad-spectrum the lazy path spends only64JVPs despite expensive projected solves, so neither cap stops it early. The failed lazy4 cost is3.76735ms; transaction plus fallback8.86188ms versus direct sequential4.87407ms. Do not hide these negative outcomes or retune caps against the observed timings.

## Evidence and replay

Read `research/coupled_economy_20261020/{CRITICAL_REVIEW_KO.md,THEORY.md,REPRODUCE.md,DAG.json}` and the run's `{COST.csv,REPORT.md,AUDIT.json,TESTS.log}`. Original per-repeat timings and full result objects are retained.

A frozen archive closeout found `REFERENCES.json` missing from the initial push: `find -size -16M` rounds upward and excluded a file below the Python16MiB splitting threshold. This is an archival defect, not an integration or metric failure. Recovery is explicitly constrained to regenerate the deterministic reference from the measured source and accept it only if its original recorded SHA256 matches. No candidate solver run or timed sample is rerun. The original failed closeout remains preserved; recovery status is linked in a subsequent comment/readback.

Shared4vCPU host diagnostics only. No optimal automatic selector, adaptive trajectory/dense-output implementation, continuous/global error certificate, strongest external-comparator result or independent-personnel review. Prior CodeRabbit authentication blocker is not reclassified or retried in this node.

**Draft, stacked on PR74, no merge/default promotion.**

prs.title: research: native JVP-only coupled stage homotopy, tests and source-bound benchmarks
prs.body:
## Delivered scope

Actual Rust implementation of the supplied report's **first native coupled step** in standalone companion `crates/vigilode-coupled`. Autonomous identity-mass ODE with supplied JVP; no original-coordinate state Jacobian assembly by the candidate. Shared basis/J0V, small all-stage homotopy/Newton correction, real concurrent stage RHS/JVP, original-space residual gate, bounded basis/lambda refinement, explicit counted sequential-MF fallback. Existing numerical crates/defaults, PR71 and PR73 remain unchanged.

This is NOT a completed adaptive trajectory dispatcher or a certified output/global-error solver. `Candidate` means operational stage-root screening passed; embedded time-error admission is a separate returned flag.

## Read first

- `crates/vigilode-coupled/README.md`: API and executable example.
- `research/coupled_native_20261020/CRITICAL_REVIEW_KO.md`: substantive results, negative controls and claim limits.
- `research/coupled_native_20261020/runs/39349031422/{COST.csv,REPORT.md,AUDIT.json}`: fixed-step cost, full raw linkage and independent computational readback.
- `research/coupled_native_20261020/closeout_runs/39349959195/{VALIDATION.json,ROOT_VS_TIME_ERROR.csv,CODERABBIT_STATUS.json}`.
- `REPRODUCE.md`, `DAG.json`, `BENCHMARK_PREREGISTRATION.md` in the same research node.

## Exact identities

Base numerical source: `c03ca90f19a9e64ba7751c069325a48b54b39c2e`.
Measured Rust and harness source: `1e4a993874d6930ea2bb41bb0ff7392f21c33df7`.
Final critical report/publication: `15c43ce76734d0a560fcec5909ac49f1e6f2d347`.
Supplied ZIP SHA256: `54f4f4a99d552388fc28d01f5f367176e301c2af15c3cd8a9c7a30b4e5dfd4f1`.

## Actual verification

- RED39345503351:3expected candidate-completion failures,2controls passed.
- Final tests:19passed,0failed. Includes matrix-free callbacks, thread bits, leakage expansion, epoch/budget/partial callback/parallel failure accounting, projected singularity, lambda endpoints, exact Riccati local-error refinement and failed-fallback structured counters.
-80accuracy rows:77pass the frozen raw-reference output/embedded-vector agreement criteria;3broad-spectrum coupled arms decline by full-space residual. Only20rows ALSO pass the embedded time-error criterion at the prescribed fixed h. Do NOT call all77 accepted physical steps.
-800fresh timing processes,3700timed step attempts,10balanced blocks.64registered pairs,61fully admitted.
- Independent computational readback:847metrics,528coupled work ledgers,770timing/calibration identities,30worker-count output-bit checks,61paired medians,82state-object hashes. Same author, not independent-personnel review.
- Closeout:112archive file hashes verified and1large reference file reconstructed. Existing numerical crates/root Cargo unchanged. No root-workspace test claim.

## What the timings do and do not say

few-mode n12288,h0.001: coupled1=12.8465ms,coupled4=6.17224ms, paired worker-speedup2.0765 with identical outputs; generic sequential MF=5.53202ms, so parallelization did NOT beat that baseline here. Small n96 threading loses.

Diffusion n96,h0.001: coupled4=0.97237ms versus generic sequential3.92616ms, and embedded time-error test passes. But native-K and raw-U root accuracy/linear tolerances differ and the baseline is not claimed strongest or optimally tuned. This is a fixed-step latency comparison, not a4x production trajectory speed claim.

Broad-spectrum candidate declines. Direct sequential=3.30140ms; trying coupled then fallback=6.61697ms. Failed speculation costs are retained. Large chain ratios at h0.01 are root-latency diagnostics for steps that fail embedded time-error acceptance.

Shared4vCPU runner, conditional bootstrap intervals, no universal speed/default promotion. Pool setup is outside the per-step timer and separately recorded; basis, nonlinear correction and full residual validation are inside.

## CodeRabbit: blocked, not zero issues

CLI installation succeeded on the runner. Semantic auth check remained unauthenticated; `coderabbit auth login --agent` returned1. No CodeRabbit review executed; issues=null. A real `@coderabbitai full review` request was posted to this PR, but no bot review was returned at the last read. Numerical readback is NOT relabelled as CodeRabbit review. Authentication output/tokens are not published.

## Preserved environment failure

Run39348756394 stopped before numerical testing because a formatting helper also edited a workflow, outside the Actions token's contents-only permission. The helper was narrowed to the new crate; no permission escalation. The subsequent numerical campaign and frozen closeout succeeded. Original logs/description remain.

**Draft; no merge. Native step/testing/benchmark/push complete within scope. External CodeRabbit review, adaptive integration, dense-output/global-error certification, full workspace validation and automatic optimal routing remain outstanding.**

prs.title: WU-23: R3 re-audit DAG (21 nodes): fixes, certificates, polynomial actions, preregistered campaigns
prs.body:
Draft. Not for merge. Stacked on WU-22 (#67); the base is its branch.

This PR implements all 21 nodes of `NEXT_DEVELOPMENT_DAG.json` in the R3 re-audit package `research/adversarial_reaudit_20261001_r3/`, which was added to #67 in `4b1be7e`/`6598abd`. The per-node closure matrix, research results, review record and open limitations are in `docs/REAUDIT_R3_CLOSURE_20261001.md`.

## 1. Nodes

| Node | Status | Main change | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| TIME-01/02/03 | Closed | Steps integrate `t_end - t` on the represented interval with exact endpoints, `FixedGrid` builds `t0 + k h`, and indivisible spans are rejected. Research replays keep the sealed clock policy. | `r3_represented_clock_contracts.rs` |
| ARITH-01/03 | Closed | Any weight loss, subnormal included, is non-converged (`TRANSFORM_ERROR_UNBOUNDED`). A flagged dense reference is not an oracle, and the G3 gate holds on it. | `r3_phi_transform_authority_contracts.rs` |
| ARITH-02/04 | Closed (research) | Directed rounding (`rodas5p_core::directed`), `ExpBound` transform bounds, and certified budget enclosures. | `transform_bound_contracts.rs`, `r3_certified_budget_contracts.rs` |
| STAT-DEV-01/02 | Closed | One raw admission for all paths, provenance-bound receipts, and a multi-process `paired-timing-campaign`. **Also** an A/A batch defect, found during the HOM-06 run and fixed in `c8aa0dc`. | `r3_raw_protocol_admission_contracts.rs`, `r3_aa_batch_contracts.rs`, CLI campaign test |
| STAT-DEV-03 | Closed | A Hoeffding Monte-Carlo gate with predeclared delta = 0.01 and no data-adaptive extension. Schema v3. | `r3_monte_carlo_gate_contracts.rs`: exact 6^6 = 46656 outcomes |
| STAT-DEV-04 | **Measured: FAIL** | Timing design contract and a coverage-study harness. | L-0007 and corrected v2 L-0010: single-case designs undercover (0.78 to 0.93) |
| HOM-01 | Closed | Named stage targets with coefficient bits, a leakage census and the block/sequential allowance. | `coefficient_structural_contracts.rs` |
| HOM-02/03/04 | Closed (research) | Outward stage certificates, inverse witnesses and the path-sum radius certificate. | `outward_certificate_contracts.rs`: 24 fixtures |
| HOM-05 | Closed | `Q2Admission::NativeTargetCertificate` skips the eighth W batch. Candidates are bit-identical. A wrong or unverified certificate falls back. | `q2_diagnostic_replacement_contracts.rs` |
| HOM-06 | **Measured: FAIL** | Matched-accuracy campaign of the certified transactional path against sequential JF-GMRES. | L-0008: every arm Blocked (0.17x at P = 1) |
| POLY-01/02 | Closed (research) | Joint Chebyshev/Laguerre phi actions. Coefficients use only correctly rounded arithmetic. Certified or EstimateOnly total error. | `r3_polynomial_action_contracts.rs`: 20 actions and 100 columns against an independent oracle |
| POLY-03 | **Measured: PASS** (measured population) | Matched-accuracy campaign against the Arnoldi fused phi. | L-0009: warm Chebyshev Promoted, 3.17x (1.17 to 13.4). Cold Chebyshev Inconclusive, cold Laguerre Blocked. |
| PROCESS-01 | Closed | Every experiment's preregistration was committed and pushed before its output, with pilot runs and incidents disclosed. Ledger L-0007 to L-0010 is appended and the existing prefix is unchanged. | `check-research-node.py --base` PASS |

## 2. Research results and authority

The stall rule is satisfied: L-0007 to L-0010 all have numeric PASS/FAIL verdicts.

Both coverage studies fail, so every paired timing decision carries `STATISTICAL_AUTHORITY_HOLD`, the POLY-03 Promote included. The host is a non-authoritative 4-vCPU cloud container. **There is no production or speed promotion.**

- **HOM-06:** the certified transactional path uses about 5x the baseline's RHS evaluations. Building the thread pool for each step makes more threads slower.
- **POLY-03:** the speedup comes only from reusing coefficients on a frozen operator.

## 3. Review and incidents

A read-only adversarial review of the diff reported 3 correctness issues, 7 accounting issues and several nits. All are resolved in `d198558`. The main ones:

- The HOM-05 model check now also compares the ODE at every stage state. A cubic regression test covers it.
- The coverage study now uses separate data and bootstrap seeds.
- The HOM-06 mismatch gate is now counted per step.
- The POLY-03 timing setup is symmetric.

The first preregistered HOM-06/POLY-03 run aborted on the A/A batch defect before any receipt. Its outputs are kept in `aborted-run-380f565/`. The rerun addendum was committed before the rerun, and it discloses the one unverified decision that was printed.

## 4. Validation at `1c54194`

One checkout, `RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1`. Every command exited 0. Commit `1c54194` differs from the run commits only in `docs/`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| fmt; clippy `-D warnings` (workspace, research, bateman, stage-certificate) | clean |
| workspace | 654 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored |
| research / bateman / stage-certificate features | 443 / 449 / 471 passed |
| ignored tests (measurement profile) | 4 passed |
| `check-audit2-readiness.sh` | 92 passed |
| python tool tests; `check-research-node.py --base` WU-22; `check-authority-refs.py`; ignored-in-CI | pass |

Edited existing tests:

- `r2_timing_authority_contracts`: a consistent forgery now also edits the Monte-Carlo count.
- `paired_timing_contracts`: reseeded ordering.
- `coefficient_structural_contracts`: clippy-only change.

## 5. What remains open

- Timing receipts are unauthenticated JSON.
- The HOM-05 model agreement is checked numerically, not proven.
- The Laguerre recurrence rounding has no propagation bound, so it stays EstimateOnly.
- A declared spectral enclosure is not verified.
- Research replay drivers keep the sealed legacy clock.
- A redesigned interval for few independent units needs a new preregistered study.
- The per-step thread pool in the transactional path is a known cost.

prs.title: WU-22: fixes for the R2 re-audit of 7708ef9 (R2-OUT-01, R2-POL-01, PHI-R1, PHI-R2, R2-STAT-01..03)
prs.body:
Draft. Not for merge. Stacked on WU-21 (#66); base is its branch. Head: `cc2cd04`.

This PR responds to the R2 adversarial re-audit of `7708ef9`, which you added to #66 in `1ba914d` (`research/adversarial_reaudit_20260930_r2/`: 7 findings, 1 P1 and 6 P2, verdict REWORK). It covers DAG nodes DEV-01 to DEV-07 (fixes) and DEV-08 (fixture regressions, one validation run, independent review). DEV-09 to DEV-14 were not started.

The fix-closure matrix, the remaining limits and the review record are in `docs/REAUDIT_R2_CLOSURE_20260930.md`.

## 1. Fixes

| Finding | Commit | Fix | Regression (audit values) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **R2-OUT-01** (P1) represented time | `df2da78`, `90df209` | Request ownership, hard-stop landing and the end of the span are decided by exact comparison. `step_to` finds an h with t + h == target and never overshoots. `land()` stretches a step that would stop short by only the rounding residue of the time sum (at most 64 eps max(\|t\|, \|t+h\|, \|target\|) and at most h/1024), and treats an overshoot within that residue as a landing rather than a shortened step. t + h == t is a typed error; a final piece that lands on tf is exempt from min_step. The Radau drivers lose their end slack. | 8-ULP span at +-1e12: 0 attempts and y = 0 before, now y = 1. The next_up(endpoint) request gave 2048, now 2049. Adjacent requests were rejected as duplicates, now recorded. Also: 0.1 x 10 lands on 1.0 in 10 steps; a 0.04 grid with h = 0.01 adds no micro-step and BDF2 keeps its error; zero-crossing grids work; an adaptive step across zero reaches tf. |
| **R2-POL-01** mixed budget | `5639a33` | The step-power term is formed on binary exponents (`rodas5p_core::binary_power`), so it has no intermediate overflow. A NaN component is rejected before `min`. | 1e-320, 1e-160, p = 2 at h = 1: budget 10 (WRMS 5 accepted) before, now 0.999988867182683 (rejected). epsilon_ref = 0 gives 0. The homotopy consumer accepts at 1.01x and rejects at 0.99x of both the step and the embedded term. |
| **PHI-R1** weights | `5639a33`, `90df209` | `weight_phi_vectors` forms h^k b_k with `times_power`. An overflow, or losing every nonzero input, is an error. A partial loss is counted in `WorkCounters::phi_weight_underflows`. | h = +-1e-100, b4 = 1e300: 0 before, now 4.166666666666667e-102 (fused, dense, prefix). h = 1e100, b4 = 1e-300: NonFinite before, now 4.1666666666666665e98. |
| **PHI-R2** dense amplitude | `5639a33` | The dense combination is evaluated on w / 2^e and scaled back. `dense_phi_combination_report` flags mixed range and outputs far below the input amplitude. | w1 = c: result 0 at c = 1e60 before; now relative error <= 1e-12 for c = 1e-200 .. 1e300 against the closed-form phi1. |
| **R2-STAT-01** sessions | `e1bc29d` | Only labelled sessions count. An unlabelled case makes the decision Inconclusive. `measure_paired_case_in_session` added. The A/A control gives authority only in exactly the candidate's sessions. `raw_cases_sha256` and `verify_against_raw` link a record to its raw cases. | One PID, 6 unlabelled cases: 6 sessions and Promote before, now 0 sessions. Candidate 0..5 with A/A 100..105: Promote before, now Inconclusive. |
| **R2-STAT-02** vector coverage | `e1bc29d`, `90df209` | Unknown coverage is absorbing under accumulation (`merged_unknown_vector_calls`, omitted while 0). Pareto fronts and attainments list unknown-cost runs as `not_evaluated_record_ids`. | 16 legacy + 1 current call: 1 vector before, now unknown. Same result in every order and grouping. |

| **PHI-P3** (P2) unfused breakdown | `1299b62` | a happy breakdown is always a checkpoint | A = -I_8, v = e1: value 0, dimension 0, unconverged -> phi_1(-0.1), dimension 1, converged |

| **CERT-02** (P3) `error_scale` | `546c229` | finite states, finite nonnegative atol | NaN on either side, negative atol: finite scale -> error |
| **AD-03** (P2) M08 NaN | `546c229` | `W e_j`, every column of `I - P W` and of `P` checked before `max` | finite W = 1e308 [[1,1],[1,1]], P = [[2,-2],[2,-2]]: certified -> error (feature `audit2-research`) |
| **B-01** (P2) global process | `882c8b0` | labels are global sessions; blocks = distinct sessions; two-way bootstrap draws sessions once for all cases | one process 77 over 6 cases: 6 blocks, Promote -> 1 block, Inconclusive (for 1, 6 and 60 cases); 60 cases in the same six sessions do not narrow the interval |

prs.body:
Draft. Not for merge. Base: the integration branch (#64). Head: `7ded8ed` (`83f0d16` plus a merge of the integration head `ff84ed6`).

The single next research node the external re-audit of 2026-09-29 asked for (RA-06, `NEXT_LOOP_PROMPT_KO.md`), run under the research-node rule of WU-16.

## 1. Node
`research/common_w_accelerator_parity_20260929/`: pre-registration committed first (`0db9918`), code (`4b2594b`), results appended with raw output and ledger row L-0005 (`83f0d16`). `tools/check-research-node.py --base origin/audit/adversarial-audit-20260927` passes.

## 2. Design
Same RODAS5P target `W K_i - g_i(K_<i)` and same h, every step of one adaptive sequential run replayed from the baseline state:
1. sequential matrix-free baseline (`sequential_stages`, GMRES rtol 1e-11);
2. predictor (previous stages scaled by h/h_prev) + 1 exact-target matrix-free common-W correction (`run_audit2_matrix_free_common_w_correction`);
3. predictor + 2 corrections, causal acceptance on the target residual (<= 1e-9 relative), charged sequential fallback.
Cases: new synthetic dissipative non-commuting 3-D ODE and semilinear n = 32; rtol 1e-4, 1e-6. No holdout.

## 3. Result: FAIL for this accelerator form

| Case, rtol | arm | W-apply | W-solves | RHS | endpoint diff (units) | fallbacks |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| dissipative-3, 1e-4 | sequential | 544 | 136 | 119 | 0 | - |
| | pred + 1 | 544 | 136 | 272 | 4.16 | - |
| | pred + 2 + fb | 1148 | 304 | 436 | 2.1e-7 | 4 |
| semilinear-32, 1e-6 | sequential | 2400 | 56 | 49 | 0 | - |
| | pred + 1 | 2400 | 56 | 112 | 1.40 | - |
| | pred + 2 + fb | 4000 | 112 | 168 | 2.1e-8 | 0 |

(all four rows in `RESULTS.txt`). One correction misses parity; two reach it at 1.8-2.1x the W applications, 2x the solves and 2.4-3.4x the RHS, with no span reduction, because each correction is a block-forward sweep of 8 common-W solves under a relative GMRES criterion. Per the pre-registered stop rule the accelerator stays off; the sequential baseline stays the default. No timing was run.

- `PhiConvergenceBasis {ResidualEstimate (default), InvariantSubspace, FullSpace}` on `PhiActionReport`, `FusedPhiSubstepReport` and `FusedPhiActionReport`. The fused action reports the weakest basis over its substeps.

- `A_46 = [[-2, 2^46], [2^-46, -2]]`, `v = e1`, `t = 1`:

| Path | converged | dimension | estimate | basis | true error |
